summary: Implemented the window title feature in the rich repo, without running tests, Black, or any repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and Control.title(title) with docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) returning True only when is_terminal (writes via self.control), with the requested docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests appended: test_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: tests were not run and Black was not available, so line lengths were checked by hand; the one overlong docstring line was shortened. Interpretation: the spec's "buffers only when show_cursor passes" was implemented as set_window_title writing through the same is_terminal check as show_cursor.
